columns.name: sku
columns.description: Stock keeping unit; part of the unique addressable (sku, location) pair (PI2).

columns.name: location
columns.description: Location the stock is filed at; part of the unique addressable (sku, location) pair (PI2).

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Stored stock level for the pair; constrained non-negative (PI2, PI3).

columns.name: inventory_code
columns.description: Combined inventory code captured at filing; opaque string for S1 (PI2, OD2).

schema_changes.detail: Create stock_records with id (uuid pk, default gen_random_uuid()), sku (text not null), location (text not null), quantity (integer not null), inventory_code (text not null); UNIQUE (sku, location); CHECK (quantity >= 0).
schema_changes.migration_note: Initial create_table. Reversible in a single step: upgrade creates the table with its columns and constraints, downgrade drops it. No pre-existing rows to preserve on an initial migration (PI4).
